_comment: Static byte budget for a tier's first load, checked by `pnpm budget` (tools/perf/budget.mjs) in CI.
Ceilings are kB (1024 bytes) on the wire, per category and for the total, the units of `pnpm transfer`:
html/js/css/svg at their brotli size, avif/webp/woff2 raw — so this table and docs/perf/wire-*.json compare directly.
Set on 2026-09-02 (#102) at the post-batch numbers plus ~5%, rounded up: desktop 1857.1 kB measured (textures 1547.1, js 248.2),
mobile 913.7 kB (textures 603.8). The AVIF path is what is budgeted; the WebP fallback path is measured in docs/perf/wire-final-webp.json.
To raise a ceiling deliberately: change the number in the same PR as the change that needs it, and say why in the PR.
